Apple samba-100.9, commit 55b54999e108fc287b6dfd5e8e5a06a60d4bc6c0
https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/samba/tree/samba-100.9

Source is copied directly into this repository, without a submodule or nested
Git checkout. The included source already contains Apple's period patches;
do not apply the original patch series a second time. Only the source/build
inputs needed for the Tiger server and native DirectoryService/VFS modules
are included. Original file notices and samba/COPYING are retained.

Tiger reports native smbd Version 3.0.10. Modern-host native SMB negotiation
reaches the authentication exchange, then the old SPNEGO parser rejects the
mechListMIC. Research candidates must verify, not discard, that integrity
message, and retain native account authentication and safe recovery.

compat/netgr.h, membershipPriv.h and ntsid.h are unmodified declarations from
Apple Libinfo-222.4.12 lookup.subproj and membership.subproj, respectively,
commit 60ca71e7b20d5c3d7521b541e93e988994f22018:
https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/Libinfo/tree/Libinfo-222.4.12
The genuine Tiger SDK omits these native exported APIs' prototypes. No Libinfo
implementation or later-host header is linked into the guest.

Local changes: research SPNEGO mechListMIC parsing/validation and directional
NTLM2 MIC generation; exchange-state cleanup; the native, already-authenticated
NetInfo account's opted-in SMB-NT session-key derivation; period header/prototype fixes;
SAMBA_DEBUGLEVEL spelling in namequery and generated build-options output;
the printer-name error branch returns NULL instead of an unspecified pointer.
config.site.tiger records measured guest-side runtime configure contracts.
The native server's build options and genuine SDK establish 64-bit off_t,
long-long, mmap and POSIX locking support. Runtime platform probes establish
Darwin's variable-length sockaddr interface iterator and native iconv. The
cross-build must not replace these with configure's unknown/disabled defaults.
Compiler-generated header dependencies are included by the build recipe;
reconfiguration invalidates derived objects so config.h changes cannot leave
the old dummy interface iterator in an apparently updated server.
Build metadata contains product/toolchain facts, not the builder's identity.
Source/scripts/tiger_samba_build.py builds this source with the genuine SDK,
not an unrelated newer Samba or a separate password database.

Source/scripts/build-tiger-samba.py publishes/reuses the native component.
Status: production integration under qualification. A
private-loopback candidate passes native authentication, client-MIC rejection,
real SMB mount read/write, Unicode filenames/rename and production Bonjour
share enumeration in8R4088. This does not qualify all signing/file-locking
semantics, updates or release integration. In
particular this OSS build has no WITH_BRLM: the genuine SDK includes Apple's
ByteRangeLocking binary but omits its private header. Do not claim native
ByteRangeLocking/VFS parity without measuring its actual interface.
